metadata.title: A Koszul-Type Splitting Theorem for Complex Supermanifolds
metadata.abstract: We study the splitting problem for complex supermanifolds using formal exponential maps and Ehresmann connections. We show that every formal exponential map induces a splitting of the underlying supermanifold. Furthermore, we establish that every Ehresmann connection determines a linearization of the infinite jet space, extending the corresponding construction for ordinary manifolds to supermanifolds. For Ehresmann connections preserving the zero section, we construct a formal exponential map in two ways: via the linearization of the infinite jet space and directly from the connection operator. We prove that both constructions yield the same map and induce the same splitting, thereby generalizing Koszul's splitting theorem from linear connections to zero-section-preserving Ehresmann connections. Finally, we provide examples showing that, without this assumption, the two constructions may yield different splittings, or one or both of them may fail to induce a splitting.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 复超流形的连接分裂框架
analysis.workSummary: 作者用形式指数映射及Ehresmann联络研究复超流形分裂。每个形式指数映射诱导分裂；每个Ehresmann联络给无限jet空间线性化。对保零截面的联络，分别经jet线性化与联络算子构造形式指数映射，证明两者一致并诱导同一分裂，推广Koszul线性联络定理。
analysis.breakthrough: 揭示更一般联络仍能保持唯一对应构造的条件，并给不保零截面时分裂不一致或失败的例子。
analysis.limitations: 形式指数映射存在性和联络附加条件不能省略，不能解释为任意复超流形无条件分裂。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。21页PDF提取完整、页数匹配、无短文本页；现有全文及元数据披露检索未发现作者AI使用声明。补检及致谢语境复核亦未见正向声明，未观察到声明不等于没用AI。
